text:
Good evening. I'm writing about my grandson, he's 5. I'm not sure if this warrants a call so I thought I'd message first. His temperature was 37.6 when I took it about half an hour ago, so not especially high I don't think. His eczema has been playing up this week, dry itchy patches on his elbows and the backs of his legs, and we've been putting the cream on as usual, so I'm not too worried about that part.

What I'm less sure about is two other things. He keeps asking me to turn the lights off, says the light hurts his eyes, and he's been holding his hand over his face when I put the lamp on. And he's not himself at all, he's very floppy and sleepy, and when I went to rouse him just now he was quite hard to wake and didn't really answer me the way he normally would, just sort of mumbled and went back off. That's not like him, he's usually a chatterbox even when he's poorly.

I might be overthinking it, but I'd rather ask. Could someone advise me please.
